messages:
cassie: Quick heads up — noticed a mismatch between the in-product help panel and our docs for "pinning" behavior. help panel says "Model Pinning" but docs use "Version pinning". This is causing customer confusion in support tickets. :thinking:
aj: Ugh. Which screen? is this in the model settings flyout?
ben (Docs): Yep, the guide we ship in the sidecar uses "version pinning". We intentionally use "version" in the docs because it's more precise when we talk about model rollouts.
noah: I saw this in Console > Models > Active model > Help (right rail). The help panel header is "Model Pinning" and the anchorid is #pin-models.
linkbot: link-checker: found 1 broken deep link in docs -> https://docs.redwood.ai/console#pin-models (404)
cassie: Could we standardize on "Version pinning" in the UI? or add a parenthetical "(version pinning)" at least for now? Need to avoid churn in naming across screens.
aj: UI thought: change header to "Version pinning" and update help panel body copy to reference the docs link. Small visual change, low risk.
ben (Docs): I can update docs copy and add an anchor alias for backwards compatibility. Also add a redirect from /console#pin-models to /console#version-pinning.
noah: I can update the help panel link target and aria-label. Quick note: current focus trap doesn't announce the panel title correctly — screen readers still read "Help" instead of the header. I'll file a tiny a11y PR.
cassie: Awesome. Plan: ben to patch docs + alias, noah to update panel copy and aria-label, aj to approve microcopy. Target: ship to staging by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup: 
ben (Docs): Will do. I'll also add a small blurb in the docs explaining "Terminology note: we use 'version pinning' in docs and 'pinning' colloquially elsewhere" to ease transition.
noah: For telemetry, recommend adding event "help_panel_open" with attribute "help_topic:version_pinning" so we can track before/after clicks.
aj: Can we sneak in a quick crosslink into the console top-level search as an alias? Might help discovery.
cassie: Yep. Noagreed. Assigning tasks in the ticket.
noah: Filing PRs now. I'll drop the PR links here when done.
ben (Docs): PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/docs/commits/2345 :eyes: 
noah: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/ui/commits/9987
cassie: Thanks team — follow up in the ticket. :sparkles:
